answer: A Verified email inbox bound by attestation certificate with annual re-verification ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the verified email inbox answers a fresh challenge, the attestation certificate is recorded, and annual re-verification keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. A falcon that appears twice is the tell: the same channel cannot back two identities. The beacon keeps the process honest and the thread keeps it open, so challengers can always recheck.
